name: Chromecore

card.summary: A style aesthetic built around reflective metallic chrome in clothing, accessories and makeup, used to give an outfit a futuristic, polished look.

quick.overview:
Chromecore is a style aesthetic organised around metallic chrome finishes: silver jackets, mirrored accessories, chrome jewellery and metallic makeup. It helps looks by giving an outfit a deliberate, high-shine futuristic identity.

It is a fashion trend rather than a procedure, and little formal research exists on it. Its details are defined by the people wearing it.
quick.how: Wearers pick reflective or silver pieces, such as metallic outerwear, sunglasses, jewellery and chrome-toned makeup, and pair them with simple dark or neutral basics so the metal stands out.
quick.risks: No health risks are specific to the aesthetic. As with any trend, pieces can date quickly and reflective finishes can show scuffs.

lead: Chromecore is a style aesthetic centred on reflective metallic chrome, applied to clothing, accessories and makeup. People use it to give an outfit a futuristic, polished look: silver or mirror-finish pieces are worn against simple neutral basics so the metal becomes the focal point. [1][2]

The Aesthetics Wiki describes it as a design aesthetic of the 2000s focused on metallic-looking objects and products, such as CDs, DVDs, early computers, phones and digital cameras, and fashion writers place its current revival within the wider early-2000s nostalgia cycle. [1] In beauty, the trend covers chrome eyeshadow, metallic glosses, mirror-effect highlighters and chrome nails. [2] As with other "-core" labels, it is defined informally by the communities that use the term, so what counts as chromecore varies between wearers.

chain: Wear metallic chrome pieces or makeup
Outfit gains a reflective, futuristic look
angle.text: Chrome-finish clothing and accessories change how an outfit looks by adding high-shine metallic accents. It is a styling choice that costs little beyond the clothes themselves.

infobox: Metallic jackets, jewellery, sunglasses, makeup, nails

paras: Chromecore uses chrome and mirror-like silver finishes as its organising idea. Typical elements are metallic jackets and outerwear, chrome jewellery, reflective eyewear and metallic eye or lip makeup. [1][2]

Fashion retail coverage ties the look to the Y2K revival and to technical outdoor and athletic wear, with examples including faux-metallic mesh hoodies, silver down jackets and chainmail-like knits, plus shimmer-detailed sneakers and metal-toned chokers and chains. [1] The revival is described as overlapping with hyperpop and techno scenes. [1]

In beauty, chromecore is described as metallic finishes in silver, gold, rose gold, copper and metallic purple, blue or pink, ranging from a subtle sheen to high shine. [2] Suggested ways to wear it include choosing metallic eyes or metallic lips rather than both, pairing shimmer with nude shades, placing metallic accents at the inner corner of the eye or on the cheekbones, and using chrome nails as a lower-commitment version. [2]
